Kit summary

Twin Fangs Soul SeverBasic
Deals 200% ATK DMG each to a single enemy 2 times. The second time inflicts 1 layer of [Bloodblade Corrosion] on the target.
Bloodblade OpeningActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Inflicts 1 layer of [Bloodblade Corrosion] on all enemies, then attacks all enemies 2 times, dealing 150% ATK DMG each time. For every 1 layer of [Ghost Remnant] self has, each attack deals an additional 1% ATK DMG. The second attack inflicts 1 layer of [Flaw] on targets with the maximum layers of [Bloodblade Corrosion], up to 3 layers.
Bloodblade Sheathing Lv.1When an ally casts a Skill to pursue and attack during Kijuro's turn, or when an ally deals Direct DMG to a Boss, Kijuro casts <Bloodblade Opening> to pursue and attack once. This effect triggers up to 1 time before Kijuro acts. When self casts <Bloodblade Opening> to pursue and attack, increases self ATK by 10% (up to 4 layers); removes all buffs from Bosses and limits the DMG they deal in the next 2 turns to no more than 25% of Kijuro's Max HP. DMG dealt by <Bloodblade Opening> to Bosses is increased by 30%. Each layer of [Ghost Remnant] additionally increases self Direct DMG by 2%. While self is in [Sheathed], enemies cannot use Basic Attacks to pursue and attack.
Bloodblade Sheathing Lv.2At the beginning of each wave, increases the Turn Meter of the ally with the highest initial ATK and the ally with the highest initial HP by 50%. When allies cast Skills to pursue and attack a total of 4 times, self gains 1 layer of [Ghostblade Retribution] (up to 3 layers). When an enemy casts a skill to pursue and attack, if self has [Ghostblade Retribution], consumes 1 layer to invalidate the pursue-and-attack skill. When an enemy casts a non-pursue-and-attack skill outside their turn, if self has [Ghostblade Retribution], consumes 1 layer to reduce that skill's DMG by 40%. When consuming [Ghostblade Retribution], casts <Bloodblade Opening> to pursue and attack once and inflicts 1 layer of [Flaw] on all enemies. When gaining an extra turn via <Hidden Edge>, reduces the CD of <Bloodblade Opening> and <Sanzu Funeral> by 1 turn.
Hidden EdgePassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2 · Lv.3
Kijuro's Basic Attack and Skill DMG will not land a Crit on non-Bosses, but guarantee to land a Crit on Bosses. At the beginning of a battle and the beginning of self's turn, for every 10% Crit DMG self has, self gains 1 layer of [Ghost Remnant] (each layer increases Skill DMG by 3% and Basic Attack DMG by 3%). Layers are rounded down; reinflicting refreshes the layers. At the beginning of a battle, enters [Sheathed]. At the beginning of self's turn, if in [Sheathed], exits it and enters [Unsheathed] (increases Basic Attack and Skill DMG dealt by 50%) until the end of self's turn. When actively casting a Skill during self's turn while in [Unsheathed], casts <Bloodblade Opening> to pursue and attack once. Each time <Bloodblade Opening> or <Sanzu Funeral> is cast as a pursue-and-attack, self gains 1 layer of [Bloodforce Edge]. Upon reaching 3 layers, consumes 3 layers of [Bloodforce Edge] and gains 1 extra turn.

Bloodblade Sheathing Lv.2At the beginning of each wave, increases the Turn Meter of the ally with the highest initial ATK and the ally with the highest initial HP by 50%. When allies cast Skills to pursue and attack a total of 4 times, self gains 1 layer of [Ghostblade Retribution] (up to 3 layers). When an enemy casts a non-pursue-and-attack skill outside their turn, if self has [Ghostblade Retribution], consumes 1 layer to reduce that skill's DMG by 40%. When consuming [Ghostblade Retribution], casts <Bloodblade Opening> to pursue and attack once and inflicts 1 layer of [Flaw] on all enemies. When gaining an extra turn via <Hidden Edge>, reduces the CD of <Bloodblade Opening> and <Sanzu Funeral> by 1 turn.
Bloodblade Sheathing Lv.3After casting <Sanzu Funeral> and dealing DMG, if the target's current HP is not lower than 50% of their Max HP, deals additional DMG equal to 5% of the target's Max HP; otherwise, deals additional DMG equal to 10% of the target's lost HP. The additional DMG dealt cannot exceed 100% of Kijuro's ATK. When hitting a Boss, additionally increases the Direct DMG and Skill DMG taken by the Boss by 30%. At the beginning of a battle, grants self 2 layers of [Bloodpact Soul Cocoon]. When entering [Unsheathed], settles and removes the DMG record effect from all allies, then consumes all [Bloodpact Soul Cocoon] layers; for each layer consumed, restores HP equal to 300% of Kijuro's ATK to all allies. If 5 allies with the [Pursue & Attack] tag are deployed: 1. After actively casting <Sanzu Funeral>, grants self layers of [Bloodpact Soul Cocoon] equal to the highest number of [Flaw] layers removed from a single enemy this time (up to 3 layers). If no [Flaw] was removed, grants 1 layer. 2. While in [Sheathed], when an enemy actively casts a Basic Attack or Skill, consumes 1 layer of [Bloodpact Soul Cocoon] to limit this DMG to no more than 25% of Kijuro's Max HP. Then increases self Turn Meter by 20%, restores HP equal to 300% of Kijuro's ATK to all allies, and inflicts 1 layer of [Flaw] on the DMG source. This effect triggers up to 1 time per unit's turn. 3. When consuming [Bloodpact Soul Cocoon], grants all allies [Bloodpact Ghost Robe] (absorbs DMG equal to 1000% of Kijuro's ATK, considered as Shield, cannot be stolen or removed, up to 2 layers), reduces Basic Attack and Skill DMG taken by all allies by 40%, and increases Basic Attack and Skill DMG they deal by 40% for 2 turns.
Sanzu FuneralActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Inflicts 2 layers of [Bloodblade Corrosion] on all enemies (each layer increases Skill DMG taken by 5% and reduces Skill DMG dealt by 5%, up to 6 layers). Then attacks all enemies 3 times, dealing 200% ATK DMG each time. For every 1 layer of [Ghost Remnant] self has, each attack deals an additional 2% ATK DMG. When dealing DMG to targets with [Flaw], ignores their Shields. For every 1 layer of [Flaw] the target has, this DMG is increased by 10%. At the end of the Skill, clears all [Flaw] from all enemies. At the end of the turn when <Sanzu Funeral> is cast, enters [Sheathed] (reduces Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG taken by 50%).
